text:
toni (People Ops): Quick sync — planning a small hybrid recognition event called \"Global Gratitude Hour\" for the end of Q2. Objectives: celebrate spot-award winners, remind folks about wellness stipend, and run a short policy Q&A about tax/timing for spot rewards. Need to lock time(s) across timezones, gift delivery options (digital vs physical), and manager approval flow. Thoughts? :handshake:

devin (Recruiting): love it. For timing, can we do two 45-min sessions same day (Americas/APAC+EMEA overlap)? Keeps each under an hour. Also want to include a 2-min shoutout for new hires.

anya (EMEA People Ops): Two sessions works. Propose 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET for the main one and 19:00 PT / 03:00 CEST for the second for APAC folks — might be late but doable occasionally. We should record and post a short highlight clip.

li (Finance): Budget note: digital gift cards are easiest for global — lower tax paperwork for small values but depends on country. Anything > $50 may be taxable in some jurisdictions. We need to capture recipient country in the fulfillment CSV.

marco (Legal): Confirming: we should add a consent checkbox in the nomination flow for public recognition and for sending physical items (addresses). Also need manager approval captured before payout for compliance in some countries.

toni (People Ops): Good flags. Action items: capture country and opt-in for shipping in the nomination form; require a manager approval step before fulfillment. We'll keep physical shipments to domestic for pilot (US+CA+UK) to avoid customs.

devin (Recruiting): For the nomination flow, I can wire a short Google Form prototype: fields: nominee name, nominator, reason (1-2 lines), recipient country, shipping opt-in (yes/no), manager email.

li (Finance): Also need payroll cutoff dates if we pay via payroll. Or use prepaid cards (vendor) to avoid payroll for small amounts. Recommend vendor route for quick turnaround — will need vendor onboarding if new.

marco (Legal): Vendor route OK but ensure vendor contract has data processing addendum for PII (addresses). Toni, coordinate with procurement if we use a new vendor.

anya (EMEA People Ops): If we go vendor/digital cards, please confirm VAT/withholding implications per country before mass sending. I can help map top recipient countries.

hr-bot: reminder set: \"Finalize nomination form + manager approval flow\" on 2201239900. :robot_face:

toni (People Ops): Plan for pilot: limit to 50 spot-award recognitions globally (digital only for EMEA/APAC; US/CA/UK physical optional). Schedule two sessions on June 28th. Action owners: Devin - form prototype by Tue; Li - recommend payout method and vendor shortlist by Wed; Marco - privacy/consent copy; Anya - country tax checklist; I'll draft announcement + runbook.

devin (Recruiting): Prototype link will be up by EOD Monday, will include a manager-approval email workflow (simple auto-email approval).

li (Finance): I'll evaluate vendor prepaid vs payroll by Wednesday and post a recommendation with cost/tax tradeoffs.

marco (Legal): I'll send a consent snippet for the form and a checklist for procurement by tomorrow.

anya (EMEA People Ops): I'll map VAT/withholding for top 8 countries and share a quick guidance doc.

toni (People Ops): Great. We'll treat this as a 1-month pilot and measure nomination volume, redemption rate, and compliance frictions. Will loop back after the pilot for next steps. Thanks all! :confetti_ball:
